query: query CatalogImages($after: String, $itemAfter: String) @inContext(country:AU, language:EN) { products(first:5,after:$after,sortKey:ID) { pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } nodes { ...ProductFields } } } fragment ProductFields on Product { id images(first:10,after:$itemAfter) { pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } edges { cursor node { __typename altText height id thumbhash url width } } } }
